corrections.superseded_statement_zh: 合法层面：可以放开，且不付合法性代价
corrections.why_superseded: the enumerated candidates are generated and filtered by the same module that is then used as the checker, so the observation cannot price the freeze against an unfrozen feasible set, and it never touches cold-chain energy, quality or installability
corrections.citable_replacement_zh: 在当前枚举规则和路线级检查范围内，存在保持在途锚点不变的不同候选计划，尚未建立完整冷链物理可行性和实际安装资格。
corrections.citable_replacement_en: Within the current enumeration rules and the route-level check, distinct candidate plans exist that keep the in-transit anchor unchanged. Full cold-chain physical feasibility and actual installability are NOT established.

corrections.superseded_statement_zh: 在每个可测相位 n_legal_candidates == n_raw_candidates，作为“冻结锚点没有合法性代价”的旁证
corrections.why_superseded: circular: n_raw_candidates is already the post-filter set. legal_actions_with() rejects non-feasible and route-check-failing actions BEFORE a candidate is ever counted, so nothing in that ratio tests the freeze
code_evidence: p2_pos01_reference.py:362-374 legal_actions() keeps only cand.feasible AND all(route_check(view, p))
probe_anchor.py:52-69 legal_actions_with() mirrors those predicates with an explicit allowed set
action_contract.py:399-409 certify_route() is computed first; only cert['feasible'] becomes a feasible candidate
action_contract.py:393-396 enumeration inserts exactly one customer into base = p.suffix at every position; it is insertion-only
corrections.stronger_point_sharper_than_originally_s: two of the five registered anchor-freeze assertions cannot fail for any candidate the enumerator can produce, because apply_action() copies anchor_node / anchor_time / anchor_load verbatim in every branch (action_contract.py:226,241,249,256). Only the exact-once assertion is genuinely exercised, and it recorded 0 failures.
corrections.what_remains_true: the 152 candidates are internally consistent: no enumerated candidate violated exact-once or moved the anchor, and every candidate passed the route-level check. That is a consistency statement about the enumerator, not a price on the freeze.

corrections.why_superseded: the candidates are the output of a generic recursive legal-insertion enumeration, NOT the output of the frozen MaskCO decoder. probe_anchor.py loads no model, no checkpoint and no decoder; its only generator is action_contract.enumerate_actions_from_plans
code_evidence: probe_anchor.py:72-85 enumerate_candidates() recurses mask orders through legal_actions_with and dedups by plan_hash
action_contract.py:377-427 _enumerate_from_plans() enumerates one insertion position per anchored slot plus one anonymous NEW_ROUTE slot
no import of any model / checkpoint anywhere in probe_anchor.py
corrections.what_the_counts_actually_are: 8 distinct plan_hashes per size-2 mask and 24 per size-3 mask (1 vs 3 masks), i.e. insertion position x vehicle assignment x insertion order. 13 of the 15 testable phases admit exactly ONE size-2 mask, and only 2 phases (queue_len = 3) admit three
corrections.what_this_does_NOT_support: there is no evidence here of rich supervision signal for learned mask selection, and no evidence that a learned reconstructor would differ from a non-learned one
corrections.what_this_DOES_support: the anchor-behind suffix is a genuinely reachable action-space region that the declared conservative domain leaves unvisited

corrections.why_downgraded: synthetic_tx.py runs StrictOnlineEnv with coldchain_contract=None and booking_horizon=None, under a hand-written ScriptedCAMR that re-installs a stored tail verbatim. There is no accept/reject commitment ledger, no C0 energy budget, no quality certification and no re-optimisation, so it exercises the ENGINE INTERFACE, not the cold-chain contract
corrections.what_it_does_support: a transaction defect of the current interface: a legal suffix cannot be written to a mid-flight vehicle, a reveal silently clears the queued tail, and persistence without prefix reconciliation breaks exact-once
corrections.what_it_does_NOT_support: that CAMR is safely installable under the real cold-chain contract, that the restored order is any good, or that the engine should now be changed

facts_established_during_this_dispositio.evidence: p2_pos01_reference.py:253 public_env() sets coldchain_contract=view.contract; view_from_json() restores ColdChainContractV2 from the saved phase
facts_established_during_this_dispositio.consequence: certify_route's temperature-class gate (action_contract.py:178-183) was active in the probe, but it is vacuous on this data because supported_temp_classes=(0,1,2) covers all three classes

facts_established_during_this_dispositio.fact: energy and quality are structurally outside the check, not merely unrun
facts_established_during_this_dispositio.evidence: action_contract.py:171-173 certify_route() returns projected_energy_kwh=None, projected_quality_loss=None, projected_thermal_margin=None unconditionally
facts_established_during_this_dispositio.consequence: no reference check in this pipeline can certify the C0 energy budget or the v2 quality contract; a future package must add that path explicitly

facts_established_during_this_dispositio.fact: route_check enforces capacity + arrival <= tw_end + depot return only
facts_established_during_this_dispositio.evidence: p2_pos01_reference.py:341-359; capacity uses view.capacity - CAPACITY_MARGIN (p2_pos01_reference.py:226-227), early arrival is legitimate because waiting is allowed
facts_established_during_this_dispositio.consequence: TW start is not a rejection criterion, and the three-way capacity-tolerance split of this repository is inherited unchanged

primary_control_status: the pre-registered primary_control was NOT executed as specified (see amendment_01.json); therefore this round is a descriptive mechanism finding and NOT a complete pre-registered comparison experiment against the conservative domain
what_remains_citable: the current declared action domain excludes the not-yet-executed suffix of an in-transit vehicle, and that exclusion is a declared conservative domain rather than a commitment-contract requirement (verified against P2-POS-01:59 and _commit())
289 saved phases decompose into 216 no-in-transit / 58 queue<2 / 15 anchor-testable
in those 15 phases, distinct anchor-invariant candidate plans exist that pass the route-level check, and the first action AFTER the anchor takes 3 distinct values in every one of them
a reveal clears mutable_suffix and a mid-flight vehicle cannot receive a suffix, so any CAMR implementation needs a plan store, a post-reveal rewrite and prefix reconciliation
